title: GoGo Monster
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Third grader Yuki Tachibana believes the fourth floor of his school is home to supernatural beings that few children and no adults can see, and he worries that newer, less friendly creatures are arriving while his ability to see them fades as he grows. Classmates mock him and teachers scold him; his only companions are the kindly school caretaker, transfer student Makoto Suzuki and an enigmatic boy called IQ who wears a box over his head (VIZ blurb via AniList; MU description).
life_message: Childhood imagination and friendship deserve respect, even as growing up changes how one sees the world.

content.note: Malevolent spirits bring chaos to the school (VIZ blurb); Psychological genre (AniList, MU).
Isolation and possible hallucinations (MU Hallucination/s, Deliberate Loner); ambiguity left open (to verify).
